size_basis: A-M-199 melt class N+1 rated envelope (A-M-282)

shell.wall_basis: study fab-page mild-steel t4 shell (no thickness booked on the node - hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

lining.basis: alumina-silica brick + castable crown hot face (duty section 3), study t115 (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

burner_tube.basis: 310S radiant tube (duty section 3): combustion products stay inside the tube; thermal_kW 30 is the node rating; the fuel class is the plant C5-C10 product (duty section 1)

machine.flue: dry flue path above the acid dew point; N1 takeoff to MET_SCRUB when energized (node design offgas)

standby.state: standby_rated tertiary N+1 of IND_MELT (A-M-282/A-M-283); energized only on a long IND_MELT outage with both electric alternates unavailable (outage_d 2.0); design-day rate zero on the graph

material.class: mild-steel shell, alumina-silica brick + castable crown hot face, 310S burner tube
material.basis: duty section 3 (X-MAT-22); CA 0 mm - dry furnace service (AQS-STD-001 shop rule)

a_mach_anchors: 8 M12 wedge anchors, plinth to slab (fasteners.csv)

N1.note: combustion off-gas takeoff on +Y at z 600 (registered layout), dry flue path above the acid dew point to MET_SCRUB (duty section 3); atmospheric open-bore DN15 tube, flush at the envelope face (duty section 4)

N2.note: atmospheric open-bore DN15 tube, flush at the envelope face (duty section 4); flush at the envelope bottom (schedule datum 50)

N3.note: atmospheric open-bore DN15 tube, flush at the envelope face (duty section 4); schedule datum 800 is the placeholder elevation - the riser stands on the shell roof and flushes at the envelope top (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

nozzle_idiom: atmospheric open-bore DN15 tube connections flush at the envelope faces (duty section 4: hose, atmospheric); the schedule outlet/bottom/top faces are mapped to compass faces by the registered layout (params.json layout block); the schedule rating column (Class 150) is carried verbatim as text; datums are the schedule placeholders (holds, WORK_ORDER W12)
